dedupe_keys.name: hlnid harmonized land nutrient irrigation dataset for the conterminous united states 1938 2020

description: HLNID gives annual land use and land cover including crop type, nitrogen and phosphorus inputs from fertiliser and manure, and irrigation extent for the conterminous United States from 1938 to 2020. It harmonises county Census of Agriculture data with land change model outputs (FORE-SCE) and remote-sensing products (NLCD, Cropland Data Layer), and is presented at 48 and 250 arc-second resolution, with a method that can produce other resolutions and absorb new inputs. Researchers at the University of Wisconsin produced it and published it on Dryad in May 2026 as a free download under CC0. Coverage is national over 83 years; it shows, for example, the expansion of irrigation in the Prairie Gateway. Caveats: updates are limited by lags in state fertiliser sales reporting, and the file formats were not listed in the metadata read. Simulation uses: long-run irrigation extent and nutrient loads as drivers for irrigation demand, water-quality and drought adaptation models. Related records: the USGS 16-theme anthropogenic influences dataset (data-usgs-anthropogenic-influences-streams-16-themes) and USGS irrigation water use by HUC12 (data-usgs-monthly-irrigation-water-use-huc12-2015).
